summary: Notification destinations — Phases 2 & 3 (per-destination delivery + UI). Notifications are now delivered per-destination instead of one payload fanned to fixed webhook/telegram channels. Each destination has its own channel/target, severity floor, category subscription (vision.alert / health.check / system), detection-field toggles, and static custom fields. Delivery model is store-once / deliver-per-destination: one canonical notification per alert is persisted + streamed (in-app feed, full fields, marked Internal so it is not delivered outbound), and each enabled destination subscribed to vision alerts receives a separately rendered payload (its own fields, its own snapshot annotation/omission via BuildAlertSnapshot, and its custom fields merged last so a custom key OVERRIDES the built-in field of the same name — custom wins). Generic notifications (camera offline, machine health, system test) fan to every destination, each self-filtering by severity + category. Domain: ChannelConfig gains a DestinationConfig list; Service.Configure builds one filteredChannel per destination (Filter = severity + categories, skips Internal) and a destByID map; new Service.DeliverTo sends a tailored payload to one destination bypassing the hub; Notification gains an Internal (json:"-") flag. mymatasan: NotifyVisionAlert builds the canonical + loops destinations via DeliverTo; VisionAlertOptions carries RawImage + Destinations; notificationChannelConfig maps settings.Destinations to domain destinations; destinations resolved at the monitor + manual-alert API via a new INotificationDestinationsProvider (notificationSettingsService.Destinations). UI: Settings → Notifications replaces the single Webhook/Telegram cards with a Delivery Destinations list (add webhook/telegram; per-card target, severity, Receives category checkboxes, Detection-fields toggles that disable when a custom field overrides the key, and a custom key/value editor); the existing GET/PUT /settings/notification round-trips the destinations (no new endpoint).
compatibility: Existing webhook/telegram settings were migrated into the destination list in Phase 1, so delivery targets carry over. Behavior change: the global 'Alert Notification Fields' config (Settings → AI) no longer affects external delivery — per-destination field toggles now control it (migrated destinations default to all-on). The in-app notification feed is unchanged (one entry per alert, full detail). Two models can't double-deliver: the canonical is Internal and never reaches outbound channels.
